ctx.x: After (inaudible) he was playing with he left Benny Axel Stordahl for Sinatra. (inaudible) 2

Yeah, yeah. Well, this is -- when I met him he was with Red Norvo Maribel at the Black Hawk in Chicago, and as I say Bill Miller and Herbie Hammer and someone else, I don't know. But any way I recorded with her then, but I don't believe that Scoops did because I think at this time Joe Eldridge had joined Nat -- I mean Roy. So I don't know whether Scoops was -- he might have been there. I know she loved Scoops' playing, but I don't know whether he was still there.

But wow, that's just amazing. I don't think I'll read any more of those books. I'll just -- any way, I worked there with Roy for quite a while. And the Three Deuces was quite a club in that anybody who was anybody in the music
